eu.e: Flood Warning: South Devon coast at Beesands, Torcross, Slapton and Dawlish
eu.area: South Devon coast at Beesands, Torcross, Slapton and Dawlish
eu.x:
High tides, strong winds and large waves are expected to cause flooding tomorrow. 

Flooding is expected 3 hours either side of high tides 

Areas at risk include exposed coastal areas at Hallsands, Beesands, Torcross, Slapton, Blackpool Sands, Teignmouth Promenade and Dawlish. The high tide at Teignmouth on Sunday morning is at 04:15. Forecast total high tide level is 2.14mAOD, which is 0.56 metr
